labels.applyTheFixedCodeFirstWhenShownUseThat: Apply the fixed code first when shown. Use that new order as the input for the next code.
labels.readTheFourInputPositionsFromLeftToRight: Read the four input positions from left to right as 1, 2, 3, and 4.
labels.tryAgainTheFirstTwoShapesStayInPlace: Try again: the first two shapes stay in place; the last two swap.

instructions.anAnswerButtonSubmitsImmediatelyAndOpens: An answer button submits immediately and opens the next question. Review answers after finishing.
instructions.chooseTheCodeThatChangesTheInputIntoThe: Choose the code that changes the input into the shown output. During a test, selecting a code submits immediately and opens the next question.
instructions.eachDigitSelectsAPositionFromTheCurrentI: Each digit selects a position from the current input. Apply any fixed code first, then choose the code that gives the final output.
instructions.eachDigitTellsYouWhichInputPositionSuppl: Each digit tells you which input position supplies the next output shape. Code 1-2-4-3 keeps the first two shapes and swaps the last two.
instructions.theFirstDigitChoosesTheShapeForOutputPos: The first digit chooses the shape for output position 1, the second chooses position 2, and so on.
instructions.traceShapesThroughNumericalCodesToMatchA: Trace shapes through numerical codes to match an input sequence to its output, inspired by the switchChallenge practice tasks.
instructions.withTwoStagesTheFirstCodeIsGivenIts: With two stages, the first code is given. Its output becomes the input for the code you must choose. Positions are counted again from that intermediate sequence.

results.correct1243SwapsTheCrossAndStar: Correct! 1-2-4-3 swaps the cross and star.
results.followTheShapesThroughTheCodesDemoAnswer: Follow the shapes through the codes. Demo answers are not saved.
